assets.name: dirt
assets.description: One tiny fantasy colony-game resource sprite: a single compact irregular clod of earth, warm ochre-brown clay with one small root sticking from the side; squat lumpy mound silhouette. 16x16 pixel art, large simple readable pixel clusters, dark warm-brown one-pixel outline, two or three flat shades, limited colours, warm upper-left highlight. Rough handmade goblin-warren aesthetic. Exactly ONE object centered, fills most of the canvas with a one-pixel transparent margin. No ground shadow, no scenery, no letters, no numbers, no frame, no sprite sheet. Clear silhouette and opaque centre, readable when displayed at six pixels. No extra tiny decorations.
